sentences.text: Akash Dewangan vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 14 June, 2024

1
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Mcrc No. 3263 of 2024
 Akash Dewangan, age 26 years, S/o Dilip Dewangan R/o Motipur,
 Ward No.3, Chouki Chikhli, Police Station City- Kotwali, District-
 Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh.

---- Applicant
 Versus
 State Of Chhattisgarh Through Station House Officer (S.H.O.) Ps
 City Kotwali, District- Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh.

---- Respondent
For applicant - Shri Balraj Gupta, Advocate appears on behalf of Shri Devershi Thakur, counsel for
the applicant.

For Respondent/State - Ms. Anuradha Jain, Pl.
Hon'ble Shri Justice Goutam Bhaduri Order 14/06/2024
1.
This is second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.

The earlier bail application was
dismissed as withdrawn on 19/01/2022 vide M.Cr.C. No.8357/2021 with a liberty to repeat the same
after examination of the prosecutrix.

2. The applicant has preferred this application for grant of bail as he is arrested in connection with
Crime No.276/2021 registered in Police Station City Kotwali, District Rajnandgaon (C.G.) for
offence punishable under sections 376(3), 506 of Ipc u/s 4, 6 of Pocso Act.
3.  As per the prosecution case, the allegation against the applicant is that he forcefully committed rape with the victim knowing that she is a minor.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that case of the applicant would show that it was a case of consent and he would submit that it is a false allegation and on the same date mother of the prosecutrix has lodged five other reports and the age of the prosecutrix has not been properly proved, therefore the applicant may be released on bail.
5. Learned State counsel opposes the prayer for grant of bail.
6. Prosecutrix has been examined and she also appeared along with her parent through video conferencing from DLSA Rajnandgaon and she objected to grant of bail to the applicant.

7. Having considered the statement which is on record and the objection made regarding grant of bail to the applicant, without any observation on the merits, I am not inclined to entertain this Akash Dewangan vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175570298/
